title: Mortality and consciousness
learning_outcomes: Explain views of mind in the context of mortality and consciousness.
Compare and distinguish empirical and metaphysical questions in the context of mortality and consciousness.
Apply mortality and value in the context of mortality and consciousness.
Evaluate and justify decisions about uncertainty in the context of mortality and consciousness.

lessons.title: Views of mind
lessons.outcome: Explain views of mind in the context of mortality and consciousness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving views of mind; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to philosophy of mind essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain views of mind from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of views of mind; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Empirical and metaphysical questions
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish empirical and metaphysical questions in the context of mortality and consciousness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving empirical and metaphysical questions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to philosophy of mind essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain empirical and metaphysical questions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of empirical and metaphysical questions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Mortality and value
lessons.outcome: Apply mortality and value in the context of mortality and consciousness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving mortality and value; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to philosophy of mind essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain mortality and value from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of mortality and value; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Uncertainty
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about uncertainty in the context of mortality and consciousness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving uncertainty; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to philosophy of mind essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain uncertainty from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of uncertainty; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of views of mind; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of empirical and metaphysical questions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of mortality and value; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of uncertainty; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Philosopher or scholar of relevant tradition; avoid treating one tradition as universal.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
